jobs.description:
The Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer will report to the Commissioning & Start-Up (CSU) Manager and lead the commissioning, start-up and performance testing of mechanical equipment and piping systems.
The role requires extensive knowledge of static and rotating equipment, piping systems, nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping testing and associated commissioning activities. Strong technical, organisational and leadership skills are essential to manage mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover in accordance with project requirements, industry standards and HSSE expectations.
Key Responsibilities
Commissioning & Start-Up
Lead commissioning and start-up activities for mechanical equipment and piping systems, coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams.
Develop and execute commissioning plans, schedules, procedures and test requirements covering mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up.
Coordinate system readiness and commissioning priorities in line with project schedules and operational requirements.
Support plant start-up, performance testing and transition to stable operations.

Mechanical & Piping Technical Leadership
Provide technical leadership for static and rotating equipment and associated piping systems.
Oversee nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping integrity testing and other pre-commissioning activities.
Ensure mechanical and piping systems comply with approved engineering specifications, relevant standards and project requirements.
Review system configuration, piping arrangements, test requirements and commissioning documentation.
Provide technical guidance to commissioning engineers, contractors and vendor representatives.

Testing & Inspection
Oversee testing and inspection of mechanical equipment and piping systems to verify integrity, functionality and readiness.
Ensure piping test packages, leak testing and mechanical inspection activities are completed and documented.
Verify completion of required inspections and tests prior to system energisation, introduction of process media or start-up.
Monitor deficiencies and ensure outstanding items are addressed before handover.

Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution
Identify and resolve mechanical and piping issues encountered during pre-commissioning and commissioning.
Work with engineering, construction, vendors and operations teams to investigate faults and implement appropriate solutions.
Identify technical constraints affecting system readiness and escalate critical issues where required.

Documentation & Handover
Maintain accurate commissioning records, including test results, checklists, punch lists and relevant as-built documentation.
Ensure commissioning documentation and completion evidence are accurate, traceable and ready for handover.
Manage punch-list close-out and support system walkdowns and acceptance activities.
Support final system handover to operations.

Performance Testing
Lead mechanical and piping aspects of plant performance testing.
Verify systems and equipment meet defined performance and operational criteria.
Support optimisation and corrective activities identified during start-up and performance testing.

HSSE & Compliance
Ensure commissioning activities comply with project HSSE requirements, industry standards and applicable regulations.
Promote safe working practices and a strong safety culture throughout mechanical and piping commissioning.
Ensure appropriate controls are applied to pressure testing, leak testing and other high-risk commissioning activities.

Stakeholder & Team Coordination
Collaborate with the CSU Manager, engineering, construction, operations, vendors, contractors and other commissioning disciplines.
Coordinate commissioning interfaces and ensure activities align with overall project objectives and schedules.
Provide leadership, technical guidance and mentoring to commissioning personnel.
Identify opportunities to improve commissioning methods, system readiness and execution efficiency.

Technical Skills
Extensive knowledge of static and rotating mechanical equipment and piping systems.
Strong expertise in nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management and piping integrity testing.
Knowledge of mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and performance testing.
Strong understanding of relevant ASME, ANSI and API standards.
Experience with piping and commissioning systems/software; SmartPlant or Hexagon experience is advantageous.
Strong planning, scheduling, resource management and project coordination capability.
API 570, ASME B31.3 or other relevant mechanical/piping certification is advantageous.
Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills.

Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 10 years' experience commissioning mechanical equipment and piping systems within major industrial projects.
Demonstrable experience with static and rotating equipment, piping systems, mechanical completion and commissioning.
Proven expertise in leak testing, flange management, piping testing, pre-commissioning, start-up and plant performance testing.
Strong knowledge of industry standards and regulatory requirements applicable to mechanical and piping systems.
Ability to lead commissioning activities within complex, fast-paced project environments.
Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder-management skills.
Proficiency with relevant commissioning systems and software.
Green hydrogen and/or green steel experience is advantageous.
Project management experience or qualifications are advantageous.
Fluent English required; Swedish language skills are advantageous but not essential.

The Dynamic Control Design team in Ludvika, Sweden is seeking a manager to take on the role as leader to support and develop the individuals, the group, and the team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead the team that is responsible for the overall performance of HVDC transmission links, focusing on the dynamic control design.

You will be tasked with ensuring that the team is adequately resourced, developed, and equipped to meet business needs, as well as ensuring that the company's culture and values are reflected in all employee practices and policies. jobs.description:
In this role you will be part of a new expanding department that will focus on type testing and type approvals within HVDC for Electrical Environment. We are part of Control & Protection for hardware design. We are designing the automation system layout with placement of circuit boards and cable channeling and more, at our sites. Our cubicles have control cabinet layout, consisting of hundreds of circuit boards for measurements, control and calculations. Our system also includes user interfaces such as HMI (Human Machine Interface), diagnostic tools and IT infrastructure and IT security. For this we utilize our in-house developed real-time platform MACH to meet the power industry’s standards.
In this position you will have a bigger scope than the actual testing. You will be part of requirements, standards, test setups, evaluating test results and be included in the actual testing. We offer an exciting and stimulating work environment in a growing business where you will be part of delivering technologies in world class. Minimum 5-7 years of experience from type testing and type approval. It is highly valued if you have tested equipment based on requirements and standards, especially within electrical hardware.
Experience of working with standards and requirements in business environment, such as IEC and IEEE.
Knowledge within EMC, climatic tests, mechanical tests and safety.

Are you driven, business‑oriented, and eager to grow within B2B sales? We are now looking for an Account Executive who will have the opportunity to be part of scaling a new, AI‑driven product within a European software group. You’ll take on a central role in a successful and ambitious team, with strong opportunities to develop and make a real impact. Sounds interesting? Keep on reading!
Movement Software is a Northern European software group focused on niched industry verticals. In our Transport, Logistics & Geodata vertical, Ecoroute/Tetrasoft, Geposit, Postnummerservice, and Dimaps form a strong ecosystem of specialized software companies. Through close collaboration, they deliver complementary solutions that help businesses improve efficiency, gain better control, and navigate an increasingly complex world.
In our companies, we develop data‑driven software solutions that solve real operational challenges for our customers. Our value-adding offering includes address & geodata solutions, geographical management tools, last‑meter delivery planning & production systems and route optimization & delivery execution platforms. Our customers are mainly within transportation, logistics, and field services – but we also help companies in other industries as well.
With our newly developed next-generation platform, Ecoroute, we are redefining how companies plan, optimize and execute their daily transportation operations. From route optimization to real-time execution, we help our customers reduce costs, improve service levels, and make better decisions every day.
About the role As an Account Executive you will play a key role in driving the growth across Sweden and other Nordic and Northern European countries. You will own the full sales cycle from first contact to signed deal, working closely with decision-makers in transport, logistics, and field service industries. You will collaborate with product and customer teams to ensure a strong fit and high-quality customer experience.
You will be part of an ambitious, high-performance environment where we push each other to improve and win together. The position is based in Malmö, Sweden, located at one of our sister companies to ensure close collaboration to Geopt’s Chief Commercial Officer, who is based in Denmark.
Your responsibilities:

Prospect, qualify, and build a strong pipeline of potential customers.

Lead customer meetings, both digital and in person, an demonstrate the value of our offerings – with particular focus on Ecoroute.

Drive negotiations and close new deals.

Work closely with your colleagues within the Customer Success and Product teams to ensure successful onboarding and long-term value for the customer.

Provide market feedback and insights that shape product and commercial development.

Who we are looking for We are looking for someone who is proactive, ambitious, and results-driven – with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to move deals forward. You will thrive in this role if you have experience with B2B sales, preferably within SaaS. We also believe that you have:

A strong set of communication skills and the ability to build trust quickly.

A comprehensive and solution‑oriented mindset.

Natural authority and execution power, combined with a positive and pragmatic attitude.

Hunter mentality.

"Grit" – you don't give up, even when the work presents challenges.

The ability to communicate fluently in both Swedish and English.

A valid driver’s license.

Experience from the transportation or logistics industry is considered a plus, as well as the ability to “speak tech,” such as understanding APIs, integrations, and technical concepts.
Interested? Contact us! Does this sound like a role and environment that would suit you? Apply, connect with us, or share this opportunity with someone you think might be a great fit.
If you have questions, reach out to Linnea Olsson, People Business Partner at Movement Software.
We are a part of Movement Software
Ecoroute is part of Movement Software (formerly Progrits), a Northern European software group consisting of around twenty entrepreneur-led companies across three business areas: Vehicle digital solutions, Transport & logistics, and the public mobility. Since 2023, Movement Software has been part of Axcel, a Nordic private equity firm with a strong focus on the technology sector.
Being part of Movement Software provides us with greater opportunities for growth and development, both as a company and as individuals, while also offering the stability and resources of a larger group.

Since 1969, Flygprestanda AB has been at the forefront of aviation performance technology. With decades of industry expertise, we develop innovative Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions that help airlines and aircraft operators worldwide perform safe and efficient takeoff and landing performance calculations.
Based in central Malmö, we combine deep aviation knowledge with cutting-edge technology to deliver solutions that make a real difference in aviation safety.
Now, we're looking for a motivated and commercially minded Sales Representative to join our close-knit Sales & Marketing team and help us reach new heights.

The opportunity
Are you a natural communicator who enjoys building relationships, discovering new business opportunities, and turning conversations into successful partnerships? Are you curious about technology and excited by the prospect of working with customers around the world?
As our Sales Representative, you'll play a key role in driving growth and expanding our international customer base. You'll connect with prospective and existing customers, present innovative software solutions, and help airlines and aircraft operators discover how our technology can support their operations.
This is a varied, hands-on role where you'll combine proactive sales, customer engagement, online product demonstrations, and account management. You'll also work closely with colleagues across engineering, software development, finance, and marketing, gaining valuable insight into both our products and the aviation industry.
What you'll be doing
Create new business opportunities by following up on inbound leads and reaching out to prospective and existing customers through calls and emails.
Build lasting customer relationships by understanding customer needs, identifying opportunities, and providing a professional, responsive experience.
Drive sales forward by preparing commercial proposals, negotiating offers, and closing deals to achieve sales targets.
Showcase our technology by delivering engaging online demonstrations that bring the benefits of our software to life.
Support our customers and sales pipeline through account administration and accurate maintenance of customer and prospect databases.
Discover new opportunities through market research, industry insights, and competitor analysis.
Collaborate across teams to ensure a smooth customer journey, from the first conversation to a successful partnership.

Who we're looking for
We're looking for someone who is proactive, organized, and motivated by results. You enjoy taking initiative, communicating with people, and finding solutions that create value for customers.
You don't shy away from picking up the phone, following up on opportunities, or starting conversations with new prospects. You're equally comfortable working independently and contributing to a collaborative team environment.
You may already have experience in sales, or you may be ready to take the next step in your commercial career. An interest in technology, digital solutions, or aviation would be a great advantage.
You'll bring:
Previous sales experience and a genuine interest in developing new business.
Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate with international customers.
Strong listening and interpersonal skills, with a customer-first mindset.
Experience using CRM systems and MS Office or LibreOffice.
The ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and organize your working day.
A structured, thorough, and solution-oriented approach to your work.
A positive team spirit and a professional attitude.

Experience in the aviation industry and a degree in business or a related field are advantageous, but not essential. Some international travel may be required.
Why join Flygprestanda?
International reach: Work with airlines and aircraft operators across the world.
Meaningful technology: Represent software solutions that contribute to safe aviation operations.
A varied role: Combine sales, customer relationships, technology, and market development.
A collaborative environment: Work closely with knowledgeable colleagues across multiple disciplines.
A strong industry foundation: Join a company with a long history of aviation expertise and a forward-looking approach to technology.

Practical information

Want to take over the technical leadership of a Nordic market leader? Skip the corporate bureaucracy, drive next-generation structural engineering, and build the new product portfolio for the infrastructure that will support the global transition to 6G. Today Cue Dee are a leading supplier to leading mobile operators, TowerCo (Tower Company) and system integrators in Europe.

This recruitment is conducted in collaboration with Jefferson Wells. However, you will be employed directly by CUE DEE AB.

Cue Dee is the Nordic market leader in telecom infrastructure solutions, with a strong market presence and office in Stockholm, Umeå and Gdansk. Backed by the stable Lagercrantz Group, we combine 45+ years of heritage with global industrial manufacturing-and we are gearing up to celebrate our 50th anniversary in 2028. We develop and sell specific steel and aluminum structures used at telecom sites and rooftops worldwide.

We design, develop, and supply optimized steel and aluminum structures, both standard and customized, for telecom sites and rooftop applications worldwide.

 We are looking for our new Head of Product Development. This is a structured succession role: you will start hands-on alongside our current R&D Manager. Within 6-12 months, you will fully take over the function, join the Management Team, report directly to the CEO, and take on formal responsibility for your own team of senior and junior designers.

The Mission: Technical Leadership, develop new products for the infrastructure for 6G Innovation
 This role is heavily weighted toward structural technology and design, giving you the mandate to shape our technical roadmap as the world prepares for the implementation of 6G.

 
Design for Manufacture: Drive mechanical and structural product development from raw requirements to market-ready products. You ensure that what you and the team design can be manufactured efficiently.
Commercial Acumen: You apply your technical expertise to lay the strategic and technical groundwork for new deals, providing our sales team with the perfect product foundation to close agreements. You need to be business driven and open to meeting and understanding customers to industrialize the customer needs into our new product portfolio.
Presence & Travel: Your base is in Kista, but you will visit our other office outside Umeå and our team in Poland. Travel is primarily within Sweden and Europe (approx. 15-20 days per year) to meet customers, production teams, and suppliers.

 

 Who You Are
 You are a sharp mechanical engineer with leadership experience who wants to make a real business impact. Telecom industry experience is welcomed but not required for this role. We place great value on strong engineering expertise in areas such as structural design, mechanics, and materials engineering. At the same time, we believe that experience from other industries can bring fresh perspectives, innovative ideas, and valuable expertise that strengthen our team and drive continuous improvement.
Leadership Experience: Proven experience leading and coaching a smaller group of engineers or product developers.
The Foundation: A relevant technical degree or engineering background, combined with a solid track record in mechanical product development and manufacturing.
The Tech & Material Edge: Knowledge in structural design and in materials, manufacturing methods, materials and particularly steel and aluminum.
Building/Structural Mindset: Since our products are installed in demanding environments (often on existing building rooftops), a solid understanding of structural engineering, load-bearing structures, or building technology is an advantage.
The Mindset: Accountable, pragmatic, and business-minded. You avoid unnecessary overengineering and focus on safety, compliance, cost-efficiency, and manufacturability.
Language: Fluent English. Swedish is a strong asset.

Why Cue Dee?
 You get the financial backing of a powerhouse group, but the speed, impact, and entrepreneurial culture of an agile, market-leading 30-person company.

Short decision-making paths, real product ownership, and direct interaction with the CEO enable you to take ideas from concept to finished product with speed and impact.

Are you passionate about creating digital experiences that make everyday work easier for colleagues around the world? Do you enjoy turning complex challenges into simple, scalable solutions that create real business value? If so, this could be the role for you.

Collaborate with internal teams and external research partners, coordinating additional resources when needed.

jobs.occupation: Embedded Software Architecture, SI ICE Control
jobs.description:
Embedded Software Architecture, SI ICE Control – Expert
Integro Consulting | Automotive & Powertrain Development | Sweden
Help shape the future of sustainable powertrain technology
Integro Consulting is seeking a highly experienced Senior Expert in Embedded Software Architecture and Spark-Ignited Internal Combustion Engine (SI ICE) Control for a consulting assignment with our client, Volvo Trucks.
This is an opportunity to contribute to next-generation powertrain technologies, particularly hydrogen-powered combustion engines and alternative fuels for heavy-duty applications.
Combining expertise in embedded software, model-based control, and engine management with technical leadership, you will help develop advanced control systems, automate engineering workflows, and explore the potential of physics-inspired AI and machine learning.
About the assignment
You will contribute to early-phase development and concept engineering within a multidisciplinary powertrain organisation. Your primary focus will be embedded software architecture and model-based control systems for spark-ignited engines, particularly hydrogen internal combustion engines (H2 ICE).
You will work across engineering disciplines to develop robust, scalable control solutions while improving software development, testing, verification, and calibration through automation. You will also investigate how physics-inspired AI/ML can enhance modelling, diagnostics, control strategies, and engineering optimisation.
Key responsibilities
Embedded software architecture: Define scalable architectures and control concepts for SI ICE applications, particularly hydrogen engines.

Engine control: Develop and integrate ECU functions for air-path management, torque modelling, combustion control, knock detection, and knock control.

Model-based development: Translate system requirements into control models, software implementations, and verified solutions.

Software integration: Integrate ECU functions with sensors, actuators, diagnostics, communication interfaces, and powertrain platforms.

Automation: Improve software development, code generation, continuous integration, testing, and verification workflows.

Calibration optimisation: Automate calibration processes, measurement-data analysis, test planning, and optimisation.

Physics-inspired AI/ML: Explore physics-based and data-driven methods for modelling, control, diagnostics, and optimisation.

Testing and verification: Support SIL/HIL testing, engine test-bench activities, calibration, and release-readiness assessments.

Technical leadership: Lead design reviews, coordinate engineering activities, provide technical recommendations, and share knowledge.

Required qualifications and experience
We are looking for a senior technical expert who can take ownership of complex engineering challenges and deliver high-quality solutions.
You should have:
An M.Sc., PhD, or equivalent expertise in control engineering, mechatronics, electronics, automation, applied physics, mechanical engineering, or a related field.

Typically 12+ years of relevant experience in powertrain development, embedded systems, or automotive product development.

Extensive experience in model-based control for spark-ignited combustion engines, including requirements, modelling, implementation, integration, verification, and calibration.

Deep knowledge of ECU function development, air-path control, torque modelling, combustion control, and knock detection and control.

Strong experience in embedded software architecture, AUTOSAR Classic, software integration, diagnostics, and automotive communication protocols.

Knowledge of functional safety and cybersecurity, including ISO 26262 and SAE J21434.

Experience with SIL/HIL testing, engine test benches, data analysis, and technical documentation.

Practical experience in automated software development, code generation, scripting, continuous integration, and automated testing.

Experience in ECU calibration and optimisation, including test planning and measurement-data processing.

Advanced working knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink and Python.

Experience with ATI Vision and/or AVL Concerto. Knowledge of ETAS INCA, ETAS ASCMO, TargetLink, and C/C++ is also relevant.

Strong technical leadership, analytical skills, and the ability to communicate complex topics clearly in English.

You are proactive, structured, and results-oriented, with the ability to challenge established approaches constructively and collaborate across engineering disciplines.
Meritorious experience
The following would be particularly valuable:
Development or calibration of hydrogen, natural gas, or other alternative-fuel SI engines, especially for heavy-duty applications.

Experience with physics-inspired AI/ML, physics-informed learning, hybrid modelling, virtual sensing, anomaly detection, or data-driven control.

Applying AI/ML to improve engineering workflows, software development, testing, or calibration.

Knowledge of software-defined vehicle architectures, AUTOSAR Adaptive, or RTOS-based solutions.

Experience in heavy-duty powertrain development, calibration, verification tools, or engineering methods.

Contributions to technical roadmaps, patents, scientific publications, or engineering competence development.

Interested in this opportunity?
If you have the expertise to advance embedded engine control and sustainable powertrain technology, we would like to hear from you.
Please submit your CV and a brief summary of your relevant experience, highlighting your expertise in embedded software architecture, SI ICE control, model-based development, ECU calibration, and automation.
Please also include your availability and any experience with hydrogen engines or physics-inspired AI/ML.
Apply through Integro Consulting to discuss the assignment and how you can contribute to this exciting development programme.

jobs.occupation: Finnish radiographers wanted for opportunity in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a qualified radiographer from Finland interested in taking the next step in your career in Sweden?
We are currently recruiting two Finnish radiographers for a smaller, well-functioning radiology department in a coastal community in central Sweden.
This is a long-term opportunity for someone who values modern equipment, close teamwork and a healthy work-life balance. The position offers daytime working hours only, with no evenings, nights, weekends, public holidays or on-call duties.
The department
You will become part of a smaller radiology department with approximately 10 employees, providing both planned and acute diagnostic imaging in close collaboration with inpatient care and primary care.
The facilities have recently been modernised and the department works with modern equipment, including:
Canon CT
Samsung conventional X-ray
Ultrasound

The team consists of radiographers, assistant nurses, a radiologist and a sonographer.
There is also close collaboration with a larger radiology department, giving you the opportunity to occasionally gain experience in an environment with a higher acute patient flow.
About the role
Your main work will be within:
CT
Conventional radiography
Planned and acute examinations

You will work closely with radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and other healthcare professionals.
Working hours are Monday to Friday, 07:30–16:00.
There are no evening or night shifts, no weekend work, no work on public holidays and no on-call duties.
Previous professional experience as a radiographer is an advantage, but not a requirement. Experience in CT and conventional radiography is particularly valuable.
Requirements
We are looking for candidates who:
Hold a radiographer qualification from Finland
Have the legal right to practise as a radiographer in Finland
Are currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
Are interested in working with CT and conventional radiography
Have good communication skills in English
Are motivated to learn Swedish
Are interested in establishing a long-term career and life in Sweden

Meritorious
Previous experience in CT
Previous experience in conventional radiography
Knowledge of Swedish
Swedish professional authorization

The location
The hospital is located in a smaller coastal community in central Sweden, with approximately 24,000 inhabitants in the local area.
The area offers a combination of small-town living and easy access to the sea, lakes, countryside and an extensive archipelago. It is particularly well suited to someone looking for a quieter lifestyle, short distances and good opportunities for outdoor activities and family life.
Schools and childcare are available locally, with good transport connections to larger cities.
Swedish language training and relocation
If you do not already speak Swedish at the required level, Swedish language training is provided and financed as part of the recruitment process.
You begin studying Swedish from Finland through individual online lessons with a private teacher while continuing your current work.
Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level B2.
After relocating, you initially work 50% as a Radiography Assistant while continuing your Swedish studies from 
B2 to C1. During this period, work takes place in the mornings and Swedish studies in the afternoons, Monday to Friday.
Once you have reached the required Swedish level and obtained Swedish professional authorization, you begin working fully as a radiographer.
Salary
During the language completion phase in Sweden, while employed as a Radiography Assistant, 
the salary is: 30,800 SEK/month gross
After obtaining Swedish authorization and starting work as a Radiographer, the starting salary for a candidate without previous professional experience is: 31,100 SEK/month gross
For radiographers with previous professional experience, the salary may be individually determined based on experience and competence.
What Dignus Medical offers you
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during and after your relocation and employment
Assistance with the process of obtaining Swedish professional authorization
Help with relocation and accommodation
Support for your family if needed
Free Swedish language training with a private online tutor

Interested in working as a radiographer in Sweden?
We look forward to hearing from you!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

🌳 Experienced Climbing Arborist Wanted – Stockholm, Sweden
Svenska Trädmästarna AB is looking for an experienced, skilled and safety-conscious climbing arborist to join our team in Stockholm.
We are looking for someone with at least 3–5 years of professional experience, preferably more, who is highly skilled in climbing, pruning, rigging and sectional dismantling. We place great importance on good climbing skills and the ability to reach far out along branches for pruning.
Trädmästarna is one of Sweden's leading tree care companies, with over 30 years of experience in the industry. We specialize in protected and valuable trees, as well as trees in historically and culturally important environments.
We take it for granted that you share our love of trees. An interest in nature conservation, ecology and biodiversity is also highly valued. A university education, particularly in biology or ecology, is a strong advantage, although climbing is the main focus of this particular position.
We are particularly interested in someone who works well with clients and colleagues and who is able and willing to take responsibility for their own projects. There are great opportunities to develop professionally and take on more responsibility.
We want to grow with good people, and that is how we believe we will continue to shape the arborist industry in Sweden over the next 30 years.
Requirements: Category B driving licence, chainsaw qualifications equivalent to Swedish levels A and B, and relevant arborist training or equivalent professional experience.
Desirable qualifications: ETW, ISA or VETcert certification, BE driving licence, chainsaw qualifications C–F and I, training in operating mobile elevating work platforms (MEWPs) and using chainsaws from a platform, and Arbete på väg (Working on Roads) qualifications 1.1–1.3.
We are happy to support the right person with further training and professional certifications.
We offer highly varied work, ranging from pruning trees in private gardens to caring for ancient veteran trees in royal parks. We work mainly in Stockholm, but also throughout Sweden and occasionally at Swedish embassies abroad.
Competitive salary for the right person.
Please visit www.tradmastarna.se to learn more about us and see what our clients say about our work.
Send your CV, a short introduction and preferably photos or videos of your work to oskar@tradmastarna.se. Please also send a copy to our Operations and Production Manager, david.rimmel@tradmastarna.se.

Shape the future of enterprise knowledge with Multiply. Design semantic information architectures, develop ontologies and knowledge graphs, and build AI-ready data foundations while contributing to VisFlow Runa, our Knowledge Platform.

About Multiply
Multiply Teknik & IT AB is a Sweden based End-to-End solution Provider specializing in Enterprise Architecture, Data & Information Management, AI, Software Engineering, and Digital Transformation.

An important part of VisFlow is Runa, our Knowledge Platform, which focuses on ontology management, knowledge graphs, semantic modelling, metadata, and enterprise information architecture.

Our vision is to be the preferred partner for Flow thinking and End-to-End Operations aspects of any business, semantically enriched knowledge foundations that bring together business concepts, information structures, relationships, and context to support data governance, interoperability, and AI-driven applications.

You will work at the intersection of Information Architecture, Data Management, Semantic Technologies, and AI, supporting organizations in developing trusted, connected, and AI-ready information foundations.

Your work will include customer-facing enterprise transformation and architecture assignments, using the technologies, platforms, and approaches best suited to each organization's needs.

Design and govern enterprise information models, conceptual models, ontologies, and knowledge graphs.

Support enterprise transformation towards AI-ready Data & Information Management.

Develop practical Data Governance frameworks, standards, and information management principles.

Improve Data Quality, Metadata Management, Master Data Management (MDM), and information interoperability.

Apply semantic technologies and knowledge representation approaches to complex enterprise challenges.

Collaborate with business, IT, architecture, and AI teams to implement sustainable information management capabilities.

Contribute expertise and practical insights to the development and application of VisFlow Runa's ontology management and Knowledge Graph capabilities.

Your Profile
We are looking for experienced, pragmatic, and hands-on professionals who combine architectural expertise with an understanding of business needs and enterprise transformation.

7+ years of experience in Information Management, Data Management, Information Architecture, or related fields.

Experience supporting enterprise-wide Data & Information Management initiatives and transformations.

Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, MDM, and Metadata Management.

Experience with enterprise information modelling, ontologies, semantic architecture, or knowledge graphs.

Knowledge of semantic technologies such as RDF, OWL, SHACL, and SPARQL.

Understanding of AI-ready data foundations, knowledge representation, and contextualized information.

Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.

A relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree.

Fluent professional English. Swedish is advantageous.

Experience with Knowledge Graph platforms such as GraphDB, Stardog, Neo4j, or Apache Jena, as well as GraphRAG and knowledge-driven AI applications, is considered advantageous.

Why Join Multiply?
Work on challenging enterprise Data & Information Management and AI-readiness initiatives.

Combine customer-facing consulting with opportunities to contribute to our own technology development.

Help shape VisFlow Runa's evolution in ontology management, semantic architecture, and knowledge graphs.

Work with different technologies and architectural approaches across complex enterprise environments.

Collaborate with specialists in Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, Software Development, and AI.

Influence how organizations connect, understand, govern, and utilize enterprise knowledge.

Location & Employment
Location: On-Site, Stockholm Area/Malmö Area

Employment: Permanent, full-time position with Multiply Teknik & IT AB.

Join Us

Join Multiply, contribute to meaningful enterprise transformation initiatives, and help us advance the future of knowledge management through VisFlow Runa.

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager, Parts and Services - Central & Northern Europe / Normet
jobs.description:
Normet is now seeking a Sales Manager to drive parts and services revenue growth and manage key customer relationships across the European mining and tunneling sector. If you are an expert within the mining sector and sales, love to travel and eager to take the next challenge in your career, don't hesitate to apply!
About the role
The Sales Manager serves as the primary point of contact for customers and is responsible for driving parts and services sales and revenue growth by maintaining and expanding existing accounts. As an active account management team member, you need to pay special attention to inventory planning, parts consumption, training, and service requirements at the mine and tunneling site level.
What we offer?
Key role in industry growth: A pivotal position driving Normet’s parts and services expansion across the European mining and tunneling sector.
International environment & dynamic travel: Work with diverse European clients and cross-functional teams, traveling up to 75% to key customer sites in central- and northern Europe.
Impact & ownership: Full accountability for key account planning, TCO modeling, and developing tailored customer solutions.
Collaborative culture: Close synergy with Service, Equipment Sales, and technical support teams across local and international offices.

Work tasks
Key responsibilities involve
Business Growth and Functional
Execution of the sales strategy for parts and services, growth within current and new customer base; responsible for leading and delivering on customer-specific monthly revenue targets.
Active management in customer planning with spare parts, consumption levels, and portfolio offerings available within Normet. Identify gaps in customer purchasing behavior and work to create solutions to penetrate new sales.
Active involvement with recommended spare parts kits and total cost of ownership modeling, pursuit of rental and used equipment opportunities.
Lead on-site review meetings (monthly/quarterly as needed) with regular site visits and interactions.
Address technical inquiries, on-site spare parts management reviews with recommended adjustments, review equipment performance and identify upgrades.
Provide feedback for engineering and production regarding quality, parts reliability, and service with an understanding of bringing forward the voice of the customer.
Active sales opportunity pipeline and customer fleet data management within Normet systems.

Financials
Assist with forecasting, aligned with expected growth and actual order intake.
Responsible for developing and executing the sales plan in a profitable and accountable fashion.
Follow up on accounts receivables of orders as required.

Collaboration and Customer Relations
Proactive customer focus to positively support the growth of Normet.
Work alongside with Service Manager and Service teams to manage regional accounts.
Coordinate with the local / international Normet order processing and technical teams.
Collaborate closely with the Equipment Sales team throughout the sales process to identify future capital and after-sales opportunities.
Develop and collect market knowledge. Identify and review the competition and relay this information to the Normet Sales and Service Teams.

We are looking for
A minimum of 5 years’ experience in mining and aftermarket sales support. Account Management experience is considered an advantage.
Excellence in written and verbal communication in English. Other Central and/or Northern European languages are seen as benefit.
Willingness to travel up to 75% of working time within Europe.
Experience with MS Office Suite, CRM systems, and sales analytics tools.
Budget/forecasting skills.
Capacity to operate in a demanding environment with competing priorities.
Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
An elevated level of responsiveness, organization, and interpersonal skills.
Detail orientation, financial acumen and a strong command of sales tools and account management.

Other Information
Permanent and fulltime position.
Travel up to 75% of working time within Europe. Your home office could be in Sweden, Norway or Austria.
Start: as soos as possible.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.
